name: Ibuka Masaya
source:
He is a former engineer who worked at Soichiro Honma Electronics, commonly known as SHE. He is the head of the third research lab, a top-notch programmer and a genius hacker. He fled because he hated SHE's involvement in the arms industry.

Currently he works at a company founded by his childhood friend [url=/c4124]Juri[/url], and his main job is deciphering special data used to make sex toys. He is basically a good person and has a good eye for others, but sometimes he will say something bad without thinking. Depending on how he's feeling, he can become a really bad person, so he gets really carried away when using sex toys.

"Humans are born naked.
So that must be... the natural state, right?
Right? Right? Yes, that's right!"

(from the game's website)
